name: Profession Progression
description: Unlock extra profession slots by leveling.

keys.label: Profession era
keys.explain: Profession era / progression lock. 0 = Vanilla: cap 300, classic 9 professions only. 1 = TBC: cap 375, Jewelcrafting available if AutoExpansionProfessions is on. 2 = Wrath: cap 425 by default here, Inscription available if AutoExpansionProfessions is on.

keys.label: Primary profession slots
keys.explain: Default primary slots before progression unlocks.

keys.label: Third slot unlocks at
keys.explain: First extra slot unlocks when the player's top two primary professions both reach this value.

keys.label: Fourth slot unlocks at
keys.explain: Fourth slot unlocks when the player's top two primary professions both reach this value.

keys.label: Include expansion professions
keys.explain: Automatically include Jewelcrafting at TBC and Inscription at Wrath.

notes: Upstream omits include.sh on purpose; the generic install touches modules/<id>/include.sh so CMake's CollectSourceFiles() discovers the module (wow-manage.sh 2122-2130).
